verdict.rationale: Tavily's public pricing page lists a self-serve pay-as-you-go rate of $0.008 per credit ('Pay only for what you use') plus 1,000 free API credits per month with no credit card required, so a developer can see per-credit pricing without contacting sales. A community user also describes Tavily as a paid per-search API. missing for 10: an evidenced table of how many credits each endpoint (search, extract, crawl, map, research) consumes, and independent hands-on confirmation of the published rates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see clear per-request or per-credit pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: $0.008 / credit · For flexible usage · Pay only for what you use
